dataset: Per-instance outputs of HELM Classic release v0.4.0 (Stanford CRFM): every canonical boolq run listed in runs_to_run_suites.json, unperturbed eval-split records, all trials. Only run names, counts, classes and public model names are published.
note: P = HELM's max_prob, exp(stored log probability of the top completion); ece_p = HELM's ece_10_bin rebuilt from P and exact_match (equal-mass 10 bins per trial, mean over trials) and gated against stats.json within 1e-09. T = exp(sum of the log probabilities of the tokens before the first token whose decoded text reaches a stop sequence); ece_answer_only uses T. Class overrun: at least half the records carry tokens past the stop. excess = stored minus answer-only log probability.
